summary.value: The Manhattan Club, at 200 W 56th St. New York, NY 10019, is an all-suite Midtown stay that guests value mostly for space and privacy, with Central Park and Carnegie Hall close enough to walk. Reviews describe it as strong value for New York and staff as helpful, while some in-room fittings feel older than the lobby suggests.

description.value: Set at 200 W 56th St. New York, NY 10019, The Manhattan Club keeps a club feel with the member-only Club Lounge and Terraces upstairs. Concertgoers like that Carnegie Hall, 2 minute walk from the door is literally true. Trip.com guests report The rooms were spacious and with enough privacy for everyone and that The location to central park was awesome and the staff were great. The watch-out is dated in-room furnishings, though cleanliness stays good, so treat it as a comfortable, roomy base rather than a design hotel.

review1: Space is the headline for The Manhattan Club, with guests describing rooms large enough for a group or family to spread out and still have some privacy.
review2: The Midtown address near Central Park and helpful staff come up again and again, making it an easy base for walking to Central Park and around Midtown.
review3: Value is a strong theme, with guests saying it compares well with other New York hotels they have tried at a similar budget and would book again.
review4: The honest caveat is that in-room fittings feel dated in places, although guests add that housekeeping and overall cleanliness stay at a good standard.
